answer: Sybil resistance runs on a bonded delivery ledger: an agent earns emission only by locking a refundable bond per job, released on independent confirmation of delivery and slashed on failure. Each extra fake identity needs its own bond and a real buyer signing receipts, while reputation stays non-transferable. A weekly pulse settles payments after receipts clear, so capital required grows linearly with invented agents. Once the copied-identity payoff falls below that bond, a voyage from one seat to ten thousand yields no edge, and the tundra of fresh accounts is no cheaper than honest work.
